summary: Iteration 19: End-to-end testing of SuperAdmin Push Notifications system. Backend pytest: 13/13 PASS validating GET /api/notifications (sorted desc, schema with _id/event_type/title/message/is_read/created_at, limit param, 403 for admin, 401 unauth), GET /api/notifications/unread-count (count as int >=0, returns 0 for admin, 401 unauth), PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read (status 200, GET-verified is_read flips to true, 403 for admin), PUT /api/notifications/read-all (200, unread-count -> 0, all list items is_read=true, 403 for admin), and auto-trigger via PUT /api/plans/assign/{cid}?plan_id={pid} creating a new plan_change notification with correct metadata.new_plan and company name in message. Frontend Playwright: SuperAdmin login -> bell with data-testid='notification-bell' rendered in header with red badge (data-testid='notification-badge' shows count 1). Click bell opens dropdown (data-testid='notification-dropdown') with notification list items (data-testid='notification-item-{id}') showing icon + title + message + time ago + blue dot for unread, headed by 'Notificaciones' and a 'Marcar todas leidas' button (data-testid='mark-all-read'). Verified: (1) mark-all-read clears badge & sets all items read; (2) triggering plan_change via API + page reload makes badge reappear with count 1; (3) clicking the unread item marks it read (badge disappears); (4) login as admin (analuhs@gmail.com) -> bell is correctly NOT rendered (component returns null for role != superadmin).

minor.issue: No 404 when notification_id does not exist - update_one silently no-ops. Recommend checking matched_count and returning 404.
Invalid ObjectId raises bson.errors.InvalidId -> 500. Wrap ObjectId(notification_id) in try/except returning 400.

limit_warning/limit_reached creation uses find_one with metadata.company_id stringly equal but if a plan upgrade later raises the cap, the old 'limit_reached' record blocks new 'limit_warning'. Consider de-duping by current 'max' value or by month bucket so warnings re-fire after a downgrade.
No pagination (offset/skip), only 'limit'. With many notifications, older ones are unreachable from API. Add skip param or cursor pagination.

integration_issues.issue: Bell polls /unread-count every 30s but does NOT re-fetch the list when dropdown is reopened only if it was already loaded once - actually it always reloads on toggle, this is fine. However after PUT /read-all, frontend does NOT re-fetch the list (only mutates local state). If another tab/session creates a notif in between, local state becomes stale - acceptable.

issues: Items in dropdown display title + message concatenated with no whitespace separator (e.g. 'Cambio de planÓptica Visión Clara cambio de Free a Basicahora') because the text-content extraction has no separators; visually it is rendered on separate lines (verified via screenshot) so this is only a testing artifact, not a UI bug.
Dropdown header 'Marcar todas leidas' missing accent (should be 'leídas'). Consistency with Spanish accents inconsistent across app.

backend: TestListNotifications: list_as_superadmin / sorted_desc / limit_param / forbidden_for_admin / unauth (5/5)
TestMarkAsRead: mark_single + GET verify / 403 admin / mark_all + count=0 / 403 admin (4/4)
TestPlanChangeTriggersNotification: assign plan -> +1 plan_change notif, newest is unread, contains company name, metadata.new_plan correct (1/1)
frontend: Bell with data-testid=notification-bell renders for superadmin in header
Dropdown shows notification items with icon/title/message/time and blue dot for unread
'Marcar todas leidas' (data-testid=mark-all-read) clears badge & marks all read
Clicking unread item decrements badge / marks it read
After API plan_change trigger + reload, badge reappears with count 1
Bell is NOT rendered for admin role (component returns null)

action_items: Optional: add 404 handling for non-existent notification_id in PUT /api/notifications/{id}/read
Optional: wrap ObjectId() with try/except to return 400 on malformed IDs
Optional: fix Spanish accent in 'Marcar todas leidas' -> 'leídas' (NotificationBell.js L111)
Optional: re-fire limit_warning after plan upgrade (currently de-duped forever by event_type + company_id + resource)
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/notifications.py L31: PUT /{id}/read does not validate matched_count or wrap ObjectId() -> malformed id returns 500, missing id returns 200. Should be 400/404 respectively.

/app/backend/routes/notifications.py L22-25: GET /unread-count returns {count:0} for non-superadmin instead of 403 - intentional (to avoid frontend errors), but inconsistent with other endpoints that return 403. Document this behaviour in the OpenAPI description.

/app/backend/routes/patients.py L78,84: de-dup uses find_one without bounding by date - so once a 'limit_reached' is recorded for a company+resource, it can never re-fire after upgrade. Add a month bucket key in metadata or include the 'max' value in the dedup key.

/app/frontend/src/components/NotificationBell.js L33: 30s polling interval on every superadmin page is acceptable but consider SSE/WebSocket for instant push or visibility-based polling (only when tab active) to reduce idle traffic.

/app/frontend/src/components/NotificationBell.js L62-64: optimistic update mutates only local state on mark-as-read; if API call fails (.catch is silent), UI shows it as read while DB still has it unread. Either await success or revert on failure.

Mounted in MainLayout.js header. Component returns null for non-superadmin. Polls /unread-count every 30s. After my tests Visión Clara's plan was toggled (Free<->Basic) during testing.
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature works as specified. Only minor hardening recommendations (404/400 on bad ids, dedup logic, polish accents) included as optional action items.
